title: status
description: Locator -> hub health heartbeat (LOCATOR_BRIEF.md section 2.4). Sent every 2 s and whenever something changes. ok is false when quality is lost, the mic isn't running, or the config is invalid. Debug data stays local: detail is a short human-readable summary, never a payload dump.

component.description: Identifies this component on the bus.

ok.description: False when quality is lost, the mic isn't running, or the config is invalid.

detail.description: Short human-readable summary, e.g. 'beacons 5/5, 3.3 fix/s, quality ok, src beacons'.
